name: icon_list
title: Icon List
summary: Text list with an icon before each item.
description: Simple text list with an svg icon before every item (default "chevron-right" in a primary-colored circle). Items are plain text (no links). Options: other icon (whole list or per item), "inline" layout (items in a wrapping row), "plain" icons (no circle), text size ("sm" / "base"). "columns": "auto" puts the items in a grid with one column per item up to 3 (1 item = 1 column, 2 = 2, 3 or more = 3; 3 columns become 2 below 1024px and every grid becomes 1 column below 768px), or a number for another maximum.
